ingest.note: Audio sent to Vonage for playback must be raw L16 PCM. Rate is set via NCCO content-type (audio/l16;rate=8000|16000|24000). 16 kHz is recommended for speech recognition.

egress.note: Inbound caller audio arrives as raw L16 PCM (16-bit signed LE). Rate matches the NCCO content-type. Packets are ~20ms slices.

potholes.note: Vonage streams raw L16 PCM, not μ-law. This is closer to model-native format — usually only a resample is needed, not a full μ-law decode/encode bridge.
The media stream connects via an NCCO connect action with a WebSocket endpoint; ensure the answer URL returns the correct NCCO with content-type before streaming.
Vonage buffers outbound audio (3072 packets ≈ 60s). Send {"action":"clear"} to flush for barge-in.

Use NCCO connect for a new human endpoint or transfer to move legs between conversations. Transfer is terminal for the source conversation; consume transfer and destination events before closing the bot WebSocket.

latency_evidence.methodology: Callsmith architecture-budget placeholder; benchmark in the deployment region before setting an SLO.

interruption.description: Send {"action":"clear"} JSON message to the WebSocket to flush all buffered outbound audio. Vonage supports this natively.
interruption.code_hint: ws.send(json.dumps({"action":"clear"})) flushes the outbound buffer immediately on interruption.
